description: A single-choice picker that renders a custom Select on desktop and a native select on mobile.
overview:
`Picker` lets the user choose one option from a short list. On desktop it renders a suiss/ui `Select` with a trigger, a popup list, labelled groups and separators. On mobile (below `48rem`, via `useIsMobile`) it renders a `NativeSelect`, so the platform's own picker wheel or sheet appears; groups become `optgroup` elements and separators are omitted.

You describe options once with `PickerItem`, `PickerGroup` and `PickerSeparator`, and the same markup drives both presentations. Use it for form fields where the options are known and do not need search; for long lists, use `SearchPicker`.
usage:
- The value is uncontrolled by default; use `defaultValue`, or `value` with `onValueChange` to control it.
- `Picker` collects the value and label of each `PickerItem` from its children so the desktop trigger can show the selected label. Pass `items` only when options are not rendered as direct or nested `PickerItem` elements.
- `PickerGroup`, `PickerItem` and `PickerSeparator` must be used inside `Picker`, or they throw.
- Give the picker an accessible name with `aria-label` or a `Label` that points at its `id`.

examples.WithValue: Starts with an initial value through `defaultValue`.
examples.Sizes: Shows the `sm` and `default` sizes side by side.
examples.Grouped: Organizes options under labelled groups with a separator and a disabled option.
examples.Disabled: Prevents opening and changing the value.
examples.Controlled: Owns the value in state with `value` and `onValueChange`.

parts.Picker: The root that renders the Select or native select and holds the value.
parts.PickerGroup: Groups related options under an optional label.
parts.PickerSeparator: A divider between groups on desktop; renders nothing on mobile.

Picker.defaultValue: The initially selected value when uncontrolled.
Picker.onValueChange: Called with the new value when the user picks an option.
Picker.placeholder: Text shown when no value is selected; on mobile it is a disabled first option.
Picker.items: Value and label pairs used to display the selected label; collected from `PickerItem` children when omitted.
Picker.id: The ID of the trigger on desktop or the native select on mobile.
Picker.name: The field name submitted with a form.
Picker.required: Marks the field as required for form validation.
Picker.className: Classes applied to the trigger on desktop or the native select on mobile.
Picker.aria-invalid: Marks the field as invalid and applies the error style.
Picker.aria-label: The accessible name of the control.
Picker.aria-describedby: The ID of an element that describes the control.

PickerGroup.label: The group's heading; becomes the `optgroup` label on mobile.

PickerItem.value: The value selected by this option.

accessibility:
- The desktop trigger has the `combobox` role and opens a `listbox`; the selected option has `aria-selected`, and disabled options have `aria-disabled`.
- Labelled groups are exposed as `group` elements named by their label.
- Escape closes the desktop list without changing the value.
- On mobile the control is a native `select`, with the platform's built-in keyboard and screen reader support.
